roles.name: admin
roles.description: Administrators are responsible for overseeing and managing the entire platform and SOC team. They are responsible for security event monitoring, management, and response. Lastly, they collect metrics to generate reports, as well as, create and maintain playbooks.

roles.name: manager
roles.description: Security Engineer's deploy, maintain, and upgrade security systems. They support the SOC's technical needs and requests on tuning system, as well as, consult the SOC for their technical perspective. They work with developers outside of the SOC team that help implement and connect APIs with security tools. Lastly, they implement playbooks and firewall policy.

roles.name: standard
roles.description: Tier 3 Analysts (also known as Threat Hunter) are responsible for investigating and responding to complex security incidents. They are involved in forensic investigations that are escalated from Tier 1/Tier 2 analysts. They look for anomalies to discover unidentified threats, stay aware of threat trends, reverse engineer external threats. Lastly, they consult on high fidelity rules, setup, and playbooks updates to educate or mentor Tier 1/Tier 2 analysts.

roles.name: tier 2 analyst
roles.description: Tier 2 Analysts investigate escalated incidents and take actions to resolve them. They work with security engineers to tune the system. Lastly, they consult on creation and modification of playbooks and build incident reports for managers

roles.name: tier 1 analyst
roles.description: Tier 1 Analysts triage assigned alerts and incidents, primarily by following pre-developed playbooks. They gather information from tools for Tier 2/Tier 3 analysts. They create and execute alerts and incidents if needed. Lastly, they share knowledge with team to improve their process.

roles.name: compliance manager
roles.description: Compliance Managers ensure the organization's adherence to information security laws, regulations, and industry standards. They develop and enforce security policies, conduct risk assessments, coordinate compliance audits, generate compliance reports, and maintain documentation to demonstrate compliance.

roles.name: developer
roles.description: Developers author code to create custom workflows or integrate with third-party applications to reduce manual tasks.

roles.name: saas:uba:administrator
roles.description: Users assigned to this role can perform administrative operations on Exabeam such as configuring the product to fetch logs from the SIEM, connecting to Active Directory to pull in contextual information, and restarting the analytics engine. The default admin credential belongs to this role. This is a predefined role provided by Exabeam and cannot be deleted.

roles.name: saas:uba:advanced-analyst
roles.description: Users assigned to this role perform day-to-day security operations and incident investigations using the Exabeam UI. They can review user sessions and account lockouts, add comments, approve activities, and perform threat hunting. This is a predefined role provided by Exabeam and cannot be deleted.

roles.name: saas:uba:tier1-analyst
roles.description: Users assigned to this role are junior security analysts or incident desk responders who support day-to-day enterprise security operations and monitoring. This role is not authorized to make any changes to the Exabeam system except for adding user, session, and lockout comments.  Users in this role cannot approve sessions or lockout activities. This is a predefined role provided by Exabeam and cannot be deleted.

roles.name: saas:uba:auditor
roles.description: Users assigned to this role only have view privileges within the Exabeam UI. They can view all activities within the Exabeam UI, but they cannot make any changes such as adding comments or approving sessions. This is a predefined role provided by Exabeam and cannot be deleted.

roles.name: saas:uba:data-privacy-officer
roles.description: This role is needed only when data masking is enabled within Exabeam. Users assigned to this role are the only users that can view personally identifiable information (PII) in an unmasked form. They can review user sessions, account lockouts, add comments, approve activities, and perform threat hunting. This is a predefined role provided by Exabeam and cannot be deleted.

roles.name: saas:uba:cloud-ops-monitoring
roles.description: This role is used by Exabeam for monitoring SaaS deployments.
